programme.title: Dog Soldiers
programme.desc: A routine military exercise turns into a nightmare in the Scotland wilderness.

programme.title: Ava
programme.desc: Ava (Jessica Chastain) is a deadly assassin for a black ops organization. When a job goes dangerously wrong she is forced to fight for her own survival.

programme.title: The Last Burma Star
programme.desc: To mark the 80th anniversary of VJ Day, explorer Levison Wood and historian Alex Bescoby set out on an urgent mission to honour the last surviving veterans of the Burma Campaign – the brutal, often forgotten chapter of the Second World War.

programme.title: Warriors Gate
programme.desc: American teenager Jack Bronson is magically transported to ancient China, where he must become a hero and rescue a beautiful princess from the clutches of the evil barbarian king.

programme.title: Spaceways
programme.desc: A British rocket scientist is accused of murdering his wife and her Soviet lover, then disposing of the evidence by shooting their remains into space. Now, the only way to prove his innocence is to venture out there himself on a cold, cold journey, accompanied only by a lovely fellow scientist who is guaranteed to keep things warm.

programme.title: Hustlers Convention
programme.desc: Released in 1973 by founding member of The Last Poets, Jalal Nuriddin, under the name Lightnin' Rod, Hustlers Convention tells the story of Sport and Spoon - two young hustlers who attend the eponymous convention, only to get tangled up in a financial disagreement that leads to a shootout, police chase and finishes with Sport on Death Row, weighing up what it all means. Taking its title from the album, Hustlers Convention the film will blend archive and photos with interviews and use unique animated sequences set tot he album. We will see the Hustlers Convention in its wider social context and Jalal's personal story as one of rap's undisputed pioneers

programme.title: Hurricane
programme.desc: HURRICANE tells the story of the Polish fliers who found themselves fighting for the freedom of their own country in foreign skies. Seen through the eyes of Jan Zumbach (Rheon), fighter ace and adventurer, it tells how the Poles, driven across Europe by the German war machine, finally made their last stand. Flying Hurricanes for the RAF over Britain, they became a key component in the legend of 'The Few'. Up against the might of the Luftwaffe they hoped that, by saving Great Britain from Nazi invasion, they were keeping the dream of a free Poland alive. In the lethal melee above England in that summer of 1940, they fought with a tenacity and skill that earned them the admiration of the whole British nation. The dogfights against superior planes cost some of the men their lives. The constant strain of gladiatorial combat took away the sanity of others. But, as Zumbach discovers as the war stutters to a close, becoming the best in the RAF is a hollow victory for the Poles. This powerful and gripping WWII RAF story is directed by David Blair (The Messenger, Away, Accused) and includes an impressive ensemble cast including Iwan Rheon (Game of Thrones, Marvel's Inhumans), Milo Gibson (Hacksaw Ridge), Stefanie Martini (Crooked House, Prime Suspect 1973), Krystof Hadek (Under the Skin, Dark Blue World) and Marcin Dorocinski (Pitbull Anthropoid).

programme.title: Adolf Hitler: My Part In His Downfall
programme.desc: Based on his WWII memoirs, Spike Milligan experiences both high-jinks and the grim realities of war when he trains with a British artillery unit.

programme.title: Borrowed Time: Lennon's Last Decade
programme.desc: A visionary documentary exploring the final decade of John Lennon's life in extraordinary detail. Follow the legend as he evolves beyond The Beatles, creating revolutionary music and standing at the forefront of anti-war protests that would make him one of the most influential pop culture icons of all time. A monumental film from the director of Hello Quo and It Was Fifty Years Ago Today... Sgt Pepper and Beyond, Borrowed Time is packed with rare archive footage, interviews and never-before-heard stories, making it a must-see for Lennon, Beatles, and music fans alike.

programme.title: RFK Conspiracy
programme.desc: Uncover the true story behind Robert F. Kennedy's passionate fight for equality, his rise in a cutthroat political system, and the assassination that brought his campaign to a tragic early end.

programme.title: Hoffa
programme.desc: Unions, mafia and politics, Jimmy Hoffa navigated them all with ease until his disappearance. But who killed him, and why? Delve deep into the life that inspired Martin Scorsese's widely acclaimed thriller The Irishman and uncover the mystery that is Hoffa.

programme.title: Mantrap
programme.desc: Lawyer Hugo Bishop is shocked when an old friend asks him to track down an escaped murderer and prove the man's innocence. With a police dragnet closing in and the escapee's wife in a state of distress, Bishop must use all his cunning to find the real murderer and clear the man's name.

programme.title: In Search of Darkness: Part 1
programme.desc: Exploring '80s horror through voices of the filmmakers and artists who shaped its legacy.

programme.title: Coming Home in the Dark
programme.desc: A teacher is forced to confront a secret from his past when a pair of ruthless drifters take his family on a nightmare road-trip.

programme.title: Dorian Yates: The Original Mass Monster
programme.desc: 6x Mr. Olympia champion Dorian Yates ushered in a new era of bodybuilding by showcasing an unprecedented amount of mass. After facing depression and a mental health collapse, he embarks to Costa Rica for a spiritual journey to explore his consciousness.

programme.title: Ronnie Coleman: The King
programme.desc: Ronnie Coleman, known as “The King” of bodybuilding, reflects on his legacy after achieving nearly 300 lbs of muscle with elite symmetry and conditioning. Now facing a spinal surgery, he confronts the lasting toll of success and his uncertain future.

programme.title: Rich Piana Chronicles
programme.desc: Rich Piana follows the controversial bodybuilder known for his larger-than-life persona and massive physique. Filmed a year before his 2017 death, it captures four raw days of his life—unfiltered, uncensored, in his own words.

programme.title: Lee Priest Vs bodybuilding
programme.desc: In the 1990s, Lee Priest was a rising bodybuilding star whose outspoken nature repeatedly clashed with the sport’s rules. This documentary reveals how he went from future champion to one of bodybuilding’s most notorious rebels.

programme.title: Calum Von Moger: Unbroken
programme.desc: 2x Mr. Universe bodybuilding champion Calum Von Moger was known for his resemblance to Arnold Schwarzenegger and dubbed Arnold 2.0. But a tragic bicep tear brought his goals to a halt and forced him to reassess his path and find a way back to the top.

programme.title: The Night Of The Hunter
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in the relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll. Shelley Winters co-stars.

programme.title: Morons From Outer Space
programme.desc: Sci-fi meets hilarity in this zany spoof about space aliens who land on Earth and become glitzy megastars. Mel Smith and Griff Rhys Jones star.

programme.title: Cry Of The Banshee
programme.desc: Vincent Price is diabolically commanding as a corrupt English magistrate who leads a crusade to rid the countryside of witches in this lurid shocker!

programme.title: House of the Long Shadows
programme.desc: The Four Kings of Horror -- Vincent Price, Christopher Lee, Peter Cushing and John Carradine -- star with Desi Arnaz, Jr. in this delightfully ghoulish comedy about a novelist, an eccentric family and a dinner party where murder is on the menu!

programme.title: Juggernaut
programme.desc: HMS Britannic is caught in a storm at sea, but the real terror is on board - seven bombs planted by a terrorist calling himself Juggernaut, who demands a high ransom in exchange for the passengers' lives. Richard Harris and Omar Sharif star.

programme.title: Spy Game
programme.desc: From the Director of Top Gun and Enemy of the State comes an unbelievable action-thriller set against a world of global intrigue, starring Academy Award winners Robert Redford and Brad Pitt. On the verge of retirement, CIA office Nathan Muir is called back into action when he learns that his one-time protégé, Tom Bishop, is in deep trouble, trapped in a foreign prison on a charge of espionage and scheduled to die in 24 hours. With the CIA deciding a rescue is too much of a risk, Muir must work against agency politics to free Bishop from his captors.

programme.title: Spooks: The Greater Good
programme.desc: When a terrorist escapes custody during a routine handover, Will Holloway must team with disgraced MI5 Intelligence Chief Harry Pearce to track him down before an imminent terrorist attack on London.

programme.title: Thirteen Days
programme.desc: Political thriller from the Director of The World's Fastest Indian and the Producers of Air Force One. In October 1962, President John F. Kennedy (Bruce Greenwood) uncovers the Soviet Union's plan to place nuclear weapons in Cuba, an arsenal with the potential to wipe out most of the eastern and southern United States in minutes. With the aid of his chief advisor (Kevin Costner), the administration has only a matter of days to find a plan to prevent disaster.

programme.title: The Other Man
programme.desc: Suspicious that his late wife (BAFTA nominee Romola Garai) was having an affair on her frequent business trips, Peter (Oscar nominee Liam Neeson) flies to Milan in search of answers, leading to obsession and paranoia as he unravels the story behind her secret second life with another man (Oscar nominee Antonio Banderas). A gripping psychological thriller from BAFTA winning director Richard Eyre (Notes on a Scandal, Iris).

programme.title: The Vampire Lovers
programme.desc: In 18th century Europe, a vampire with lesbian tendencies ravages the young girls and townsfolk who, years earlier, killed off her fellow vampires.

programme.title: Birdman Or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)
programme.desc: In an effort to jumpstart his career after his superhero movie franchise dies, a psychotic actor writes, directs, and stars in a Broadway play that becomes an unlikely hit after he tries to shoot himself in the head during the premiere.

programme.title: Hellboy: The Crooked Man
programme.desc: In the 1950s, Hellboy is enlisted to aid rookie paranormal researcher, Bobbie Jo Song, in the transportation of a deadly creature. However, their mission soon goes awry when an accident leaves them stranded in the forests of rural Appalachia, where a small community resides, haunted by demonic forces. With all clues pointing towards witchcraft as the culprit, Hellboy and his allies must hunt down the source of this evil - a being known as 'The Crooked Man' who has been sent to Earth to harvest souls for the devil.

programme.title: Runner, Runner
programme.desc: A college student (Justin Timberlake) takes the ultimate gamble when he goes to Costa Rica to confront the online gaming tycoon (Ben Affleck) who cheated him out of his winnings.

programme.title: Looking For Eric
programme.desc: Looking For Eric is the heart-warming and hilarious tale of downtrodden Eric (Steve Evets), a postman who's life is slipping through his fingers. That is until, with a little help from his family, his mates and, believe it or not, his hero Eric Cantona, he gets his life back on track. With a cast of familiar faces such as John Henshaw (The Royle Family), Gerard Kearns (Shameless), Justin Moorhouse (Phoenix Nights) and Eric Cantona as himself. Looking for Eric will put a big smile on your face and restore your faith in the power of the human spirit.

programme.title: Sound Of Freedom
programme.desc: The global box office sensation, based on an incredible true story, this gripping drama packed with tension shines a light on even the darkest of places. After rescuing a young boy from ruthless child traffickers, a federal agent learns that the boy's sister is still captive and decides to embark on a dangerous mission to save her. With time running out, he quits his job and journeys deep into the Colombian jungle, putting his life on the line to free her from a fate worse than death. Starring Jim Caviezel (The Passion of the Christ, The Thin Red Line), Academy Award winner Mira Sorvino (Mighty Aphrodite, The Replacement Killers), and Emmy nominee Bill Camp (12 Years a Slave, The Killing of a Sacred Deer).

programme.title: The Curse Of Frankenstein
programme.desc: The Curse of Frankenstein returns, directed by Terence Fisher and starring the legendary duo of Peter Cushing as Baron Frankenstein and Christopher Lee as the Creature, performing together for the very first time! Experience Hammer's first colour horror, which redefined the genre and established the studio's signature gothic style that would change the face of horror filmmaking forever. After years of intense study, Victor Frankenstein brings a dead animal back to life through the power of science. Now overawed with success, he decides that he must build the perfect human being - from body parts!

programme.title: The Mummy
programme.desc: In the 1890s a team of British archaeologists discover the untouched tomb of Princess Ananka but accidentally bring the mummified body of her high priest back to life. Three years later back in England a follower of the same Egyptian religion unleashes 'The Mummy' to exact grisly revenge on the despoilers of the sacred past.

programme.title: George Michael: Portrait Of An Artist
programme.desc: The definitive documentary film exploring the incredible story of beloved music sensation, George Michael. Packed with rare archive footage and candid interviews from the likes of Stevie Wonder, Stephen Fry, Piers Morgan, and many more of his close friends and colleagues, witness George Michael's meteoric rise to superstardom like never before. This fascinating documentary exposes, honestly and respectfully, the man who he was, with unprecedent insights into both his professional persona as a world-renowned celebrity, and his tumultuous personal life that nearly brought his career to an early end.

programme.title: The Gangster, The Cop, The Devil
programme.desc: After barely surviving a violent attack by an elusive serial killer, crime boss Jang Dong-su finds himself forming an unlikely partnership with local detective Jung Tae-seok to catch the sadistic killer known as K.

programme.title: Driven Underground
programme.desc: Single mother Sarah Palmer hides her family in Oregon when her daughter Christy becomes a key witness in a murder against the mob.

programme.title: Gosford Park
programme.desc: Set in the 1930's, a group of rich and famous guests gather for a weekend of relaxation at a hunting resort. But when a murder occurs, each one of them becomes a suspect... An Oscar winning, satirical black comedy from one of America's greatest filmmakers, Robert Altman, featuring: Maggie Smith, Helen Mirren, Kristin Scott Thomas, Richard E. Grant, Charles Dance, Stephen Fry and Michael Gambon.

programme.title: Tank Girl
programme.desc: In this laugh-a-minute, futuristic Thriller, a mega-villain controls the world's water supply, and it's up to Tank Girl and her outrageous cohorts to end his greedy reign.

programme.title: What if Hitler Had Won the War?
programme.desc: The documentary addresses a “classic” in counterfactual history-writing: a Nazi victory in the Second World War. In addition, the program pursues the question how history would have evolved if Hitler had died early.

programme.title: Throw Momma From The Train
programme.desc: In this black-Comedy spin-off of Alfred Hitchcock's STRANGERS ON A TRAIN, a writing student tries to persuade his instructor to trade murders.

programme.title: Scream and Scream Again
programme.desc: A deranged scientist, seeking to create a race of super humans by means of organic transplant, commits a series of brutal murders in order to utilize the bodies. Screen and horror legends Vincent Price, Christopher Lee and Peter Cushing star!

programme.title: Even Money
programme.desc: Gambling addiction bring the stories of three otherwise unconnected people together as it destroys each of their lives.

programme.title: The Hurricane
programme.desc: From Oscar nominated director Norman Jewison (Moonstruck, In the Heat of the Night) comes a tense biographical drama based on the true story of Rubin 'Hurricane' Carter (Oscar winner Denzel Washington), a man who rose up from his troubled childhood to become a boxing champion. However, he loses everything when he is wrongfully convicted of murder. Years later, his story is discovered by a compassionate young teenager, who becomes determined to set him free.

programme.title: First Snow
programme.desc: A psychic's ominous reading sends a man into a tailspin.

programme.title: Soldiers Of Fortune (2011)
programme.desc: Christian Slater stars as a special-forces officer hand-picked to lead a team of rich thrill-seekers into a real-life military mission. But when the plan backfires, McCenzie and his squad find themselves fighting a furious battle to survive.

programme.title: Stay Hungry
programme.desc: Jeff Bridges and Sally Field star in this quirky, sensitive drama about a wealthy Southern bachelor who learns that money and charm have their limitations. Arnold Schwarzenegger also appears.

programme.title: Twice Told Tales
programme.desc: A Terrifying Trilogy of Passion, Poison and Possession! It's spine-tingling terror in triplicate as virtuoso of horror Vincent Price (Tales of Terror) dials up the depravity in this spellbinding trilogy of Nathaniel Hawthorne's chilling classics!

programme.title: End Of Days
programme.desc: Ex-cop-turned-bodyguard Jericho Cane (Arnold Schwarzenegger) uncovers a demonic plot when he prevents the assassination of his wealthy Wall Street employer (Gabriel Byrne). It transpires that Cane's boss is none other than Satan himself, come to take a young woman, Christine York (Robin Tunney), as his bride, who was secretly anointed by a satanic cult at birth. By doing so, on the eve of the new millennium Satan shall bring about the end of days as foretold in the Book of Revelation. With the help of his partner, Chicago (Kevin Pollak), Cane now attempts to protect Christine from both the devil, and a group of priests who believe that her death is the only way to halt Armageddon.

programme.title: The Family Man
programme.desc: Investment broker, Jack (Nicolas Cage), finds his fast-lane lifestyle turned upside down when he wakes up in an alternate suburban universe where his sports car and girlfriend have become a mini-van and wife. He soon finds himself at a crossroad between his high-power career and the woman he loves. Also starring Don Cheadle and Jeremy Piven.

programme.title: Theater Of Blood
programme.desc: Vincent Price, in a role both madcap and touching, stars as an actor taking vengeance on the critics who fail to appreciate his genius, killing them in a series of murders based on Shakespeare. Diana Rigg plays Price’s Cordelia-like daughter.

programme.title: Under Fire
programme.desc: A political thriller about three journalists on the line in 1979 Managua, Nicaragua (during the Samoza regime), how their lives intertwine and how two of them risk their professionalism by becoming involved in the revolutionary conflict.

programme.title: Rollerball (1975)
programme.desc: James Caan stars as a rollerball champ in this fast-hitting, action- packed glimpse of a future where a brutal, no-holds-barred sport takes the place of war, and murder is just part of the game.

programme.title: Bending The Rules
programme.desc: Theo Gold, the New Orleans Assistant District Attorney, is about to have the worst day of his life. Not only does his wife decide to leave him on the eve of his birthday, but he manages to lose a high-profile case.

programme.title: Once Bitten
programme.desc: A centuries-old vampiress comes to Los Angeles and stalks male virgins, she needs their blood to retain her youth and beauty. Her targets are left with an appetite for raw hamburgers and a tendency to sleep during the day so as to avoid sunlight.

programme.title: ¿Dónde Están?
programme.desc: Since 1993, hundreds of poor women from Ciudad Juárez have disappeared and nothing has been done.

programme.title: The Krays: Gangsters Behind Bars
programme.desc: Steve Wraith had a fascination with the Krays, and after writing them letters Reg took an instant liking to him, even requesting Steve visit with his brother Ron, in Broadmoor.

programme.title: The Krays : The Mafia Connection
programme.desc: Were the Krays' connected to the US Mafia? Featuring interviews and revelations from former US mobster and Dave Courtney's last ever interview.

programme.title: Sex, Fame & Murder: The Luka Magnotta Story
programme.desc: This documentary chronicles the life and crimes of former gay porn star Luka Magnotta who was convicted of killing and dismembering a man and posting the video online.

programme.title: 10 Most Evil Serial Killers
programme.desc: Explore the dark and twisted world of the Top Ten Victorian Serial Killers. From evil gangs with their hearts set on vengeance to sick and twisted doctors who used their knowledge to take numerous lives, the world of the serial killer knows no bounds.

programme.title: Gangster No 1 - The Freddie Foreman Story
programme.desc: In this feature documentary, Foreman reveals the untold and audacious details of the heists, double crossings, shootouts, murders and betrayals he was involved in, earning him the label of Gangster No. 1.

programme.title: The Krays - Myth Behind The Legend
programme.desc: Ronnie and Reggie Kray remain two of the most infamous criminals in British history. Legends to many, their fame was built on a fearsome reputation and almost mythical celebrity-like status, but who were the real Kray twins?

programme.title: The Feared: Irish Gangsters
programme.desc: Best-selling author Bernard O Mahoney returns to his home country to shine a light on the Irish underworld. He travels around Ireland to examine the workings of criminals, telling stories of violence and the devastating consequences it all brings.

programme.title: The Krays: Kill Order
programme.desc: This is the inside story of the Krays, told by those who stood with them and those who stood against them.

programme.title: Generation Iron
programme.desc: A documentary examining the sport of pro bodybuilding today providing access to the lives of bodybuilding stars Phil Heath, Kai Greene, Branch Warren, Dennis Wolf, Victor Martinez, Roelly Winklaar and more on their journey to be crowned Mr. Olympia.

programme.title: Strength Wars: The Movie
programme.desc: Strength Wars: The Movie follows eight athletes training for the ultimate strength competition, where different disciplines collide. With only one winner crowned the strongest, the film explores who truly has the power to dominate.

programme.title: The Hurt Business
programme.desc: From the producers of ‘Bowling for Columbine’, ‘Fahrenheit 9/11’ and ‘Generation Iron’, ‘The Hurt Business’ is narrated by Kevin Costner and details the lives of martial arts superstars, including Jon Jones, Georges St-Pierre and Ronda Rousey competing in one of the fastest growing sports in the world and the struggles and triumphs that accompany all careers in cage fighting. Besides featuring legends, such as Georges St-Pierre, and up-and-comers in the sport the film covers the history of mixed martial arts fighting, from the coliseums of ancient Greece to modern day venues such as the MGM Grand in Las Vegas, all expertly narrated by Kevin Costner. Themes of injury both mental and physical are explored and the question is raised; is it worth it to sacrifice one’s mind and body for sport?

programme.title: Born To Overcome
programme.desc: Kevin Levrone is a bodybuilding legend. A 90's era workhorse who always showcased a stellar physique and retired in 2003. Born To Overcome follows Kevin's return to bodybuilding and showcases the struggles of his comeback. Was it all worth it?

programme.title: CT Fletcher: My Magnifcent Obession
programme.desc: Deemed one of the most influential and motivated fitness trainers - explore the pain, struggle, and hardships endured throughout the life of famed powerlifter CT Fletcher.

programme.title: Generation Iron 2
programme.desc: From the director of Generation Iron comes a sequel following five bodybuilding superstars chasing the perfect physique. Featuring Kai Greene, Calum Von Moger, Rich Piana, Jay Cutler, Flex Wheeler, Iris Kyle, Lee Haney, and more.

programme.title: Generation Iron 3
programme.desc: Generation Iron 3 attempts to answer the ultimate question: what is the ideal and perfect bodybuilding physique? Traveling across the globe to India, Brasil, Europe, Africa, and the USA - what body type should be championed the absolute best in the world?

programme.title: Generation Iron: Natty 4 Life
programme.desc: Featuring world-renowned natural bodybuilder Mike O'Hearn, Generation Iron 4 investigates professional natural bodybuilding and the truth behind its claims. As science advances, the film asks: can any league truly guarantee its athletes are natural?

programme.title: Generation Iron Persia
programme.desc: In the Middle East, bodybuilding is king. Generation Iron Persia follows four Persian bodybuilders at different stages of their careers as they prepare for competition, each facing unique struggles while embodying the spirit of Persia.

programme.title: Rocky Marciano: A Life Story (2006)
programme.desc: This is the ONLY documentary sanctioned by the Marciano estate. This well-crafted film chronicles the life of the Brockton Blockbuster, the only retired undefeating boxing champion in history.

programme.title: Cristiano Ronaldo: Portuguese Prodigy
programme.desc: A natural leader capable of inspiring runs, powerful strikes and the ability to find the back of the net, he is what many deem to be a perfect footballer.

programme.title: Gazza: The Real Me
programme.desc: Join Danny Baker and others as they go behind the scenes with Paul Gascoigne to find out more about the real character behind the headlines and the real man off the field.

programme.title: Under the Lights: Maradona
programme.desc: Diego Armando Maradona was an iconic yet controversial football player. Over the course of his life he became, and will always be remembered as, one of the greatest players in history.

programme.title: Game On
programme.desc: The World Cup is a major event that requires seemingly endless time, money and patience. Game On goes behind the scenes to check out what happens in the lead up to the World Cup.

programme.title: David Beckham: Rise And Rise Of Beckham
programme.desc: International soccer star David Beckham's star has steadily been on the rise since his professional debut. Seemingly unstoppable, the boy-hero rose from obscurity to stardom.

programme.title: George Best: Legend and Genius
programme.desc: Best together with Denis Law and Bobby Charlton formed the holy trinity at Man Utd. Georgie was the youngest and many believe the greatest of any player to pull on a pair of boots. A moving tribute of the Belfast boy who dominated the world of football.

programme.title: David Beckham: Stamina
programme.desc: David Beckham was one of the all-time greatest footballers, one of the most famous men in the world, exceptionally wealthy and living what appeared to be a fairytale existence.

programme.title: Gazza: All the Best Paul
programme.desc: Paul Gascoigne was one of the finest footballers of his generation. Sadly, he is remembered by some as a clown who failed to use his full talent. This compilation of his finest moments from his club career, especially at Spurs, sets his reputation right.

programme.title: Matt le Tissier: Unbelievable
programme.desc: Le Tissier didn’t score ordinary goals, his strikes were powerful phenomena, and he could dribble through the densest defence.This authorised film tells his story and shows his special talents and unbelievable goals. All of them.

programme.title: Don't Take Me Home
programme.desc: The story of the Welsh international football team's rise through the FIFA World Rankings, and onto their first international tournament for 58 years.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Episode 1. Ronnie O'Sullivan teaches snooker fundamentals, guiding viewers through the essential skills and techniques to improve their game, the Rocket Method!

programme.title: Mr Calzaghe
programme.desc: The life story of undefeated world boxing champion from Wales Joe Calzaghe.

programme.title: Facing Ali
programme.desc: What is it like to face the most renowned fighter in the world? Three-time World Heavyweight Champion Muhammad Ali defeated almost every top fighter of the golden age of boxing. Now experience Ali like never before: through the eyes of his biggest rivals.

programme.title: Fight Life
programme.desc: Starring different fighters in different points in their careers, Fight Life brings you a spectrum of different point of views in the fight game. This profession of mixed-martial arts has finally flourished into mainstream America.

programme.title: Ferrari 312B
programme.desc: In a race against time and all odds, the revolutionary F1 racing car Ferrari 312B will get back on the Monaco circuit, 46 years later, under the wing of it's creator, the genius engineer Mauro Forghieri.

programme.title: Harry And Snowman
programme.desc: This is the Cinderella story of immigrant Harry DeLeyer and the plow horse he rescued from slaughter. Together, Harry and Snowman beat the odds, winning jumping competitions and worldwide fame.

programme.title: The Equalizer
programme.desc: Every year, athletes keep going higher, farther and faster, shattering previous world records. But are today’s record holders really better than those of the past? Or do modern athletes get their edge from their high tech gear? The Equalizer investigates.

programme.title: Iron Men
programme.desc: In 2016 English Premier League football team West Ham United bid farewell to their sacred Boleyn Ground, after 112 years.

programme.title: Pele: The King Of Football
programme.desc: Pele was a phenomenal athlete who brought class to the game. Using his global profile to great effect, Pele supported policies for improving the social conditions of the poor.

programme.title: A Survey of Open Space
programme.desc: The film follows a pair of urbanites set out on a 4000-mile cross-continental bicycle ride in search of the last wild place in America, to their dismay, they get exactly what they asked for.

programme.title: Muhammed Ali: Fighting Spirit
programme.desc: A history tells of how world champion boxer Muhammad Ali earned his career.

programme.title: KAKA: A Legend In The Making
programme.desc: Named FIFA World Player in 2007, Kaka is regarded as 1 of the greatest players to grace the pitch. Talented, compassionate & charismatic, Kaka truly is 'a legend in the making'.

programme.title: The Weight of Gold
programme.desc: A look at the mental health challenges Olympic athletes often face.

programme.title: Secrets of Dark Fest
programme.desc: Ten of the world's best mountain bike riders gather to compete against one another in South Africa for Dark Fest, a unique and ambitious free riders event.

programme.title: Zinedine Zidane: Zizou The Great
programme.desc: FIFA World Player in 1998, 2000 and 2003, Zidane has been labeled the greatest player to ever come out of France.

programme.title: Counterattack 2022
programme.desc: Join Sabbatical entertainment as we examine the teams selected to play in the World Cup Qatar 2022. Discover the cities and stadiums where the matches were played, and explore the art and culture of the host nation in our program: Counterattack.

programme.title: Manchester United: We Are United
programme.desc: Manchester United Football Club has come a long way since its humble beginnings as a works team for the Lancashire and Yorkshire railway depot back in 1878.

programme.title: Draw
programme.desc: Around the world there is an ongoing debate over whose country had the best sports era. Maradona + Messi, Pelé + Neymar, Valderrama + James, Chicharito + Hugo Sánchez. Sabbatical Entertainment settles the debate in this original production,

programme.title: Ronin
programme.desc: When an international team of former Cold War intelligence adversaries meet in a Warehouse, their venture of friendship, intrigue and betrayal has just begun.

programme.title: Life With Music
programme.desc: In this life affirming story of hope, struggling pianist finds inspiration with a free-spirited music critic.

programme.title: Masters Of The Universe
programme.desc: The fantastic exploits of He-Man and his arch rival, the evil Skeletor, are brought to the big screen for the first time in this live-action adventure.

programme.title: Triangle
programme.desc: A group of friends suffer a yachting accident and take refuge on a cruise drifting on the open sea, but quickly realize they were better off on the upturned yacht. Starring: Liam Hemsworth, Melissa George, Bryan Probets, Michael Dorman, Joshua McIvor.

programme.title: What Happens In Vegas
programme.desc: Two strangers who drunkenly get married in Vegas fight over a huge jackpot.

programme.title: The Client
programme.desc: The Mafia wants to keep 11-year-old Mark Sway quiet, and a federal prosecutor wants to learn exactly what he knows. So Mark finds a lawyer who's smart and tough, and she wants to help him. If he can only trust her…

programme.title: Return of the Pink Panther
programme.desc: The hilarious, accidentally brilliant Inspector Clouseau once again takes on his archenemy, the insane Dreyfus, as he plots to control the world.

programme.title: No Way Out
programme.desc: A morally upright naval hero accepts a position with the Secretary of Defense and his somewhat overzealous assistant. Things become a bit sticky when the Secretary of Defense becomes involved in the murder of a beautiful Washington, D.C. party girl.

programme.title: In Time
programme.desc: Justin Timberlake and Amanda Seyfried co-star in this sci-fi thriller set in a future world where aging stops at 25, and the only way for one man to stay alive is to steal more time.

programme.title: Wrongfully Accused
programme.desc: Ryan Harrison is framed for murder and must prove himself innocent by finding a mysterious one-eyed, one-armed, one-legged man after escaping from a bus accident on the way to jail.

programme.title: Jumper
programme.desc: A man discovers that he possesses the ability to instantly teleport anywhere in the world.

programme.title: Ghost World
programme.desc: The story of neo-cool Enid and Rebecca who, faced with graduation from high school take a hard look at the world they wryly observe. When Rebecca focuses her attention on mutual romantic fixation Josh, the girls friendship is forever changed.

programme.title: Black Knight
programme.desc: When a wisecracking black hustler from South Central L.A. finds himself transported back to medieval England, he leads the overthrow of an evil king and wins the heart of a proto feminist woman.

programme.title: Stigmata
programme.desc: A priest from the Vatican is sent to visit a woman who's showing signs of stigmata. The priest comes to find that the lady is truly possessed by something.

programme.title: The Possession
programme.desc: When a young girl buys an antique wooden box, she has no idea of the terror living inside—until the malicious spirit takes possession of her in this gripping tale of horror.

programme.title: Delta Force
programme.desc: An aircraft is hijacked by Lebanese terrorists. The terrorists demand that the pilot take them to Beirut. They don't realize is that an elite team of commandoes led by Major McCoy and by Colonel Alexander (Marvin) as been called into service.

programme.title: The Last Legion
programme.desc: As the Roman empire collapses, young Romulus Augustus must leave the city and set out for a dangerous journey to Britain to locate his last legion of supporters.

programme.title: Legend
programme.desc: Two young people are entangled in the ongoing battle between good and evil.

programme.title: Season of the Witch
programme.desc: His faith broken by years of battle as a crusader, Behmam, a medieval knight, returns to central Europe to find his homeland decimated by the Black Plague.

programme.title: Made In America
programme.desc: When Zora Mathews goes searching for her biological, anonymous sperm donor father, she and her Afro-centric mother Sarah are dumbfounded to discover Hal Jackson, an obnoxious used car salesman on late-night TV; and worse than that, he's white.

programme.title: Meet Dave
programme.desc: A crew of miniature aliens operate a spaceship that has a human form

programme.title: Just My Luck
programme.desc: Sexy Manhattanite Ashley is known as the luckiest woman around, but after a chance romantic encounter with down-and-out Jake, she realizes that she's swapped her fortune for his.

programme.title: Scoop
programme.desc: An American journalism student in London scoops a big story, and begins an affair with an aristocrat as the incident unfurls.

programme.title: Drop Dead Gorgeous
programme.desc: In the small town of Mount Rose, Minnesota, a teen beauty pageant is about to unleash a fury of very unladylike behaviour. For in this contest, going after the crown is not just a fairy-tale dream but an all-out war where you win any way you can... or die trying. A wickedly twisted, razor sharp satire with an all-star cast including Golden Globe Nominee Kirsten Dunst, Golden Globe Nominee Ellen Barkin, Academy Award Winner Allison Janney, Golden Globe Winner Kirstie Alley, Academy Award Nominee Amy Adams, Brittany Murphy and Denise Richards.

programme.title: Bedazzled
programme.desc: Elliot Richards is a hapless young man consumed by unrequited love, and desperate to change his life, he makes a deal with the devil who slyly promises to do just that — for a price.

programme.title: The State of Things
programme.desc: The crew is running out of money to finish their film.

programme.title: Every Thing Will Be Fine
programme.desc: One day, driving aimlessly around the outskirts of town after a trivial domestic quarrel, a writer named Tomas accidentally hits and kills a child. Will he be able to move on?

programme.title: Palermo Shooting
programme.desc: After the wild life-style of a famous young German photographer almost gets him killed, he goes to Palermo, Sicily to take a break. Can the beautiful city and a beautiful local woman help him calm himself down?

programme.title: The American Friend
programme.desc: Tom Ripley, who deals in forged art, suggests a picture framer he knows would make a good hit man.

programme.title: The Salt of the Earth
programme.desc: Wim Wenders doc on the photographer Sebastiao Salgado and his work.

programme.title: Tokyo-Ga
programme.desc: Moved by the work of director Yasujirô Ozu, Wim Wenders travels to Japan in search of the Tokyo seen in Ozu's films.

programme.title: Buena Vista Social Club
programme.desc: Aging Cuban musicians whose talents had been virtually forgotten following Castro's takeover of Cuba, are brought out of retirement by Ry Cooder, who travelled to Havana in order to bring the musicians together, resulting in triumphant performances of extraordinary music, and resurrecting the musicians' careers.

programme.title: The Square
programme.desc: Christian's next art installation \\"The Square\\", invites passersby to altruism. The museum's PR agency has created an unexpected campaign for \\"The Square\\". The response is overblown and sends Christian and the museum, into an existential crisis.

programme.title: Winter's Bone
programme.desc: An unflinching Ozark Mountain girl hacks through dangerous social terrain as she hunts down her drug-dealing father while trying to keep her family intact.

programme.title: Things to Come
programme.desc: Nathalie is a philosophy teacher with a settled existence, juggling a rich life of the mind with the daily demands of career and family. But with the bombshell revelation that her husband is leaving her, the pillars of her life crumble, leaving her adrift but with a newfound sense of liberation.

programme.title: Insignificance
programme.desc: Four 1950s icons meet in the same hotel room and two of them discover more in common between them than they ever anticipated.

programme.title: True Mothers
programme.desc: A woman with an adopted child is contacted unexpectedly by the child's birth mother.

programme.title: Manderlay
programme.desc: A story of slavery, set in the southern U.S. in the 1930s.

programme.title: Breathe In
programme.desc: When a foreign exchange student arrives in a small upstate New York town, she challenges the dynamics of her host family's relationships and alters their lives forever.

programme.title: Force Majeure
programme.desc: A wickedly funny psychodrama of a model Swedish family—Tomas, his wife, and their children— on a skiing holiday. An avalanche suddenly bears down on them. Tomas makes a decision that leaves him struggling to reclaim his role as family patriarch.

programme.title: Flux Gourmet
programme.desc: Set at an institute devoted to culinary and alimentary performance, a collective finds themselves embroiled in power struggles, artistic vendettas and gastrointestinal disorders.

programme.title: Trishna
programme.desc: The story of the tragic relationship between the son of a property developer and the daughter of an auto rickshaw owner.

programme.title: Spring Blossom
programme.desc: A 16 year old girl, bored with her own age group, becomes involved with an older man at a theater she passes.

programme.title: Plan 75
programme.desc: Chie Hayakawa's thought-provoking drama, set in the near future, imagines a world where a country with a low birth rate and dwindling workforce takes drastic steps to alleviate the burden of its ageing population. By introducing new legislation called Plan 75, the Japanese government offers the elderly a painless death and modest compensation to spend as they wish in their remaining days. The film holds a mirror to our world, questioning what happens to society when we start valuing cold economic calculations over the richness of the human experience.

programme.title: Blackthorn
programme.desc: Sam Shepard is Butch Cassidy in this thrilling western about the legendary outlaw's return from exile. After years of quiet, he embarks on his greatest adventure since his glory days with the Sundance Kid.

programme.title: Only You
programme.desc: Lindsey and Jake meet on New Year’s Eve, fight over a taxi and end up having a one-night-stand. Inseparable over the following weeks they quickly fall in love and move in together. Less than a year later a trip to the doctor leads to them being pressurised to put themselves on a list for IVF treatment. They reluctantly agree. We watch them naively embark on a journey that soon threatens to ruin their relationship.

programme.title: The Sweet Hereafter
programme.desc: This film documents the effects of a tragic bus accident on the population of a small town.

programme.title: What Maisie Knew
programme.desc: In New York City, a young girl is caught in the middle of her parents' bitter custody battle. Starring Julianne Moore, Steve Coogan and Alexander Skarsgård.

programme.title: Chronic
programme.desc: David is an in-home nurse who works with terminally ill patients. Efficient and dedicated to his profession, David develops strong, even intimate, relationships with each person he cares for. But outside of his work, David is ineffectual, awkward, and reserved-effects of his chronic depression-and he needs each patient as much as they need him. Having long carried a burden of guilt and remorse, David must face his past in order to heal.

programme.title: I, Anna
programme.desc: The lives of a beautiful divorcee and a troubled detective intersect during the investigation of a vicious murder on the grimy, rain-soaked streets of London, sparking a tangled web of passion, intrigue, and deceit.

programme.title: Pina
programme.desc: Wim Wenders' Oscar-nominated documentary about the life and work of the late Pina Bausch, celebrated dance choreographer, featuring spellbinding performances from her Tanztheater Wuppertal dancers.

programme.title: Borg vs. McEnroe
programme.desc: The story of the legendary 1980s tennis rivalry between the placid Björn Borg (Sverrir Gudnason) and the volatile John McEnroe (Shia LaBeouf).

programme.title: 13 Assassins
programme.desc: A group of elite samurai are secretly enlisted to bring down a sadistic lord.

programme.title: Beyond the Reach
programme.desc: A high-rolling corporate shark and his impoverished young guide play the most dangerous game during a hunting trip in the Mojave Desert.

programme.title: Fading Gigolo
programme.desc: Fioravante decides to become a professional Don Juan as a way of making money to help his cash-strapped friend, Murray. With Murray acting as his "manager", the duo quickly finds themselves caught up in the crosscurrents of love and money.

programme.title: Blind Ambition
programme.desc: Four Zimbabwean men form their country's first Wine Tasting Olympics team.

programme.title: Ice and the Sky
programme.desc: A chronicle of the professional and emotional journey of scientist Claude Lorius, who left in 1957 to study the Antarctic ice and is regarded as the first person to discover global warming and prove its existence. The documentary catches up with Lorius as he attempts to leave a life legacy — a greater consciousness of the damage that humanity is doing to their planet.

programme.title: A Late Quartet
programme.desc: Starring Philip Seymour Hoffman and Christopher Walken, members of a world-renowned string quartet struggle to stay together in the face of death, competing egos and insuppressible lust.

programme.title: Our Little Sister
programme.desc: A story that revolves around three sisters who live in their grandmother's home and the arrival of their 13-year-old half sister.

programme.title: The Humans
programme.desc: Based on the Tony Award-winning play, a family gathers for Thanksgiving in their daughter's apartment. Amidst the warmth and humor of the holiday, the tight-knit family tries to hold together in the face of an anxious and uncertain future.

programme.title: Nénette
programme.desc: A documentary on a 40-year-old orangutan that is locked behind bars.

programme.title: Life of Crime
programme.desc: A pampered housewife (Jennifer Aniston) is kidnapped by a pair of blundering ex-cons in an effort to extort money from her sleazy real-estate tycoon husband (Tim Robbins).

programme.title: 20,000 Species of Bees
programme.desc: Estibaliz Urresola Solaguren's delicate debut is a tender, heartfelt drama that follows an eight-year-old trans girl (played by Sofía Otero, winner of the Silver Bear for Best Leading Performance at 2022's Berlin Film Festival) during an indelible summer holiday of self-discovery, offering a child's eye view of growing up and delving into its lead's struggles with humanity and grace.

programme.title: Barking Dogs Never Bite
programme.desc: In Bong Joon-ho's directorial debut, a couple is driven to distraction by a yapping dog located in their apartment complex. Determined to relieve their annoyance, they take extreme action against his tormentor.

programme.title: Shirley
programme.desc: A famous horror writer finds inspiration for her next book after she and her husband take in a young couple.

programme.title: Jimi: All Is By My Side
programme.desc: A drama based on Jimi Hendrix's life as he left New York City for London, where his career took off.

programme.title: The Sun
programme.desc: Alexander Sokurov's film about Emporer Hirohito's surrender at the end of World War II.

programme.title: The Goalkeeper's Fear of the Penalty
programme.desc: Goalkeeper Josef Bloch is ejected during a game for foul play. He leaves the field and goes to spend the night with a cinema cashier.

programme.title: Faces Places
programme.desc: Director Agnes Varda and photographer/muralist J.R. journey through rural France and form an unlikely friendship.

programme.title: Rage
programme.desc: A young blogger at a New York fashion house shoots behind-the-scenes interviews on his cell-phone.

programme.title: El Bulli: Cooking in Progress
programme.desc: Documentary tracing a year in the creative life of legendary chef Ferran Adrià, whose restaurant El Bulli was acclaimed as the world's finest.

programme.title: The Truth
programme.desc: Starring Catherine Deneuve, Juliette Binoche and Ethan Hawke. About a stormy reunion between a daughter and her actress mother, Catherine, against the backdrop of Catherine's latest role in a sci-fi picture as a mother who never grows old.

programme.title: The Hunter (2011)
programme.desc: A ruthless mercenary with a secret agenda comes to Australia to search for the last remaining Tasmanian Tiger. As his dramatic hunt for the elusive Tiger goes on and he discovers the mysteries hidden within the wild landscape, long-forgotten emotions resurface. Can a human who has led an immoral life find connection and redemption too? Based on the acclaimed novel by Julia Leigh, The Hunter is a powerful psychological drama that tells the story of Martin (Willem Dafoe), a mercenary sent from Europe by a mysterious biotech company to the Tasmanian wilderness on a dramatic hunt for the last Tasmanian Tiger. Directed by Daniel Nettheim, The Hunter stars Academy Award® nominee Willem Dafoe (Antichrist, Spider-man, The English Patient, Platoon), Frances O'Connor (Artificial Intelligence, AI, Mansfield Park) and Sam Neill (The Dish, Jurassic Park, The Piano).

programme.title: So Long, My Son
programme.desc: Two married couples adjust to the vast social and economic changes taking place in China from the 1980s to the present.

programme.title: Il Divo
programme.desc: In Rome, at dawn, when everyone is sleeping, one man is awake. That man is Giulio Andreotti. He's awake because he has to work, write books, move in fashionable circles and, last but not least, pray. Calm, crafty and inscrutable, Andreotti is a synonym of power in Italy for over four decades. At the beginning of the Nineties, this impassive yet insinuating, ambiguous yet reassuring figure appears set to assume his seventh mandate as Prime Minister without arrogance and without humility. Approaching seventy, Andreotti is a gerontocrat who, with all the attributes of God, is afraid of no one and does not know the meaning of awe, since he is accustomed to seeing it stamped on the faces of all his interlocutors. His satisfaction is muted, impalpable. For him, satisfaction is power, with which he has a symbiotic relationship. Power the way he likes it. Unwavering and immutable, from the outset. He emerges unscathed from everything: electoral battles, terrorist massacres, slanderous accusations. He is untouched by it all, unchanging. Until the strongest counter power in Italy, the Mafia, declares war on him. Then things change. Perhaps even for the enigmatic, immortal Andreotti. But the question is: do they really change or only appear to? We can be sure of one thing: it is difficult to tarnish Andreotti, the man who knows the ways of the world better than any of us.

programme.title: Wreckers
programme.desc: Wreckers is an evocative drama that examines the fragile relationship between truth, intimacy and betrayal.

programme.title: The Lunchbox (English Subtitles)
programme.desc: A mistaken delivery in Mumbai's famously efficient lunchbox delivery system connects a young housewife to an old man in the dusk of his life as they build a fantasy world together through notes in the lunchbox. Gradually, this fantasy threatens to overwhelm their reality. The Lunchbox is the story of the life we dream of versus the life we live in, and of the courage it takes to turn our fantasies into reality.

programme.title: Le Havre
programme.desc: In this warmhearted portrait of the French harbor city that gives the film its name, fate throws young African refugee Idrissa (Blondin Miguel) into the path of Marcel Marx (André Wilms), a well-spoken bohemian who works as a shoe-shiner. With innate optimism and the unwavering support of his community, Marcel stands up to officials doggedly pursuing the boy for deportation.

programme.title: Manglehorn
programme.desc: Left heartbroken by the woman he loved and lost many years ago, Manglehorn, an eccentric small-town locksmith, tries to start his life over again with the help of a new friend.

programme.title: Play
programme.desc: An astute observation based on real cases of bullying. In central Gothenburg, Sweden, a group of boys, aged 12-14, robbed other children on about 40 occasions between 2006 and 2008. The thieves used an elaborate scheme called the 'little brother number' or 'brother trick', involving advanced role-play and gang rhetoric rather than physical violence.

programme.title: Love & Friendship
programme.desc: Lady Susan Vernon takes up temporary residence at her in-laws' estate and, while there, is determined to be a matchmaker for her daughter Frederica, and herself too, naturally.

programme.title: Shine
programme.desc: Pianist David Helfgott, driven by his father and teachers, has a breakdown. Years later he returns to the piano, to popular if not critical acclaim.

programme.title: Jazz on a Summer's Day
programme.desc: The highlights of the 1958 Newport Jazz Festival.

programme.title: Dogman
programme.desc: Marcello, a small and gentle dog groomer, finds himself involved in a dangerous relationship of subjugation with Simone, a former violent boxer who terrorises the entire neighbourhood. In an effort to reaffirm his dignity, Marcello will submit to an unexpected act of vengeance.

programme.title: Still Life
programme.desc: A government worker charged with finding the family members of those who have died alone is assigned to his final case - and finds himself on a liberating journey that allows him to finally start living his own life to the fullest.

programme.title: Essential Killing
programme.desc: Captured by the US military in Afghanistan, Mohammed (Vincent Gallo) is transported to a secret detention center somewhere in Europe. When an accident allows him to escape, Mohammed must confront the necessity to kill in order to survive.

programme.title: Kaboom
programme.desc: A hilarious erotic romp about a group of hot bisexual college kids hopping in and out of bed with each other while an evil cult plots to destroy the world.

programme.title: Bandits
programme.desc: The suave Joe and his hypochondriac partner Terry have escaped from prison. Cutting a swath from Oregon through California, these fugitives rob banks in order to finance their scheme for a new life south of the Border.

programme.title: Agent Cody Banks
programme.desc: To his family and friends, Cody Banks is a typical teen. But Cody has a secret - he's actually part of an undercover teen CIA program and has 5 years of special training under his belt.

programme.title: Agent Cody Banks 2: Destination London
programme.desc: Traveling to London, Agent Cody Banks attends a prestigious school where he gets close to a man who is working with his arch villain Molay.

programme.title: Three Amigos!
programme.desc: Steve Martin, Chevy Chase and Martin Short are three wild and crazy caballeros in this comedy adventure that’s a fiesta of fun. Co-starring Phil Hartman and Jon Lovitz, the '¡Three Amigos!' blaze a side-splitting trail across the comedy frontier!

programme.title: The Return of the Living Dead
programme.desc: Two employees of a medical supply company accidentally release a toxic gas that raises up the dead. Soon the town is overrun with flesh-eating residents of the local cemetery who are hungry for human brains.

programme.title: Species III
programme.desc: In the ongoing fight for supremacy between mankind and the human-alien hybrids, a fatal hybrid weakness has given humans the advantage. Until now.

programme.title: Pork Chop Hill
programme.desc: Gregory Peck heads an all-star cast in this true re-enactment of the terrifying Korean War that brilliantly pulls the viewer inextricably into the crossfire that surrounds American foot soldiers.

programme.title: King Solomon's Mines
programme.desc: Experience wild stunts, romance and heart-pounding excitement with Richard Chamberlain as a soldier of fortune who unwittingly gets tied into a young woman's (Sharon Stone) search for her missing father.

programme.title: Legend of the Lost
programme.desc: Told against the sweeping panoramas of the Sahara desert, this epic features an exotic mix of action, suspense, and romance and delivers a caravan of excitement - with screen icons John Wayne and Sophia Loren fighting to survive an arduous journey!

programme.title: Support Your Local Gunfighter
programme.desc: James Garner is back in the saddle again as hustler Latigo Smith whose latest con is passing off cowhand Jug (Jack Elam) as the dreaded gunman Swifty Morgan. But when the real Swifty shows up, the Wild West is going to get a whole lot wackier!

programme.title: Trail of the Pink Panther
programme.desc: This tribute to the late Peter Sellers contains unused scenes from the previous Pink Panther films interspersed with new footage and features a great comedic cast.

programme.title: A Shot in the Dark
programme.desc: Peter Sellers and Elke Sommer star in this successful sequel to The Pink Panther in which Inspector Clouseau tries to prove a beautiful parlor maid is innocent of killing her chauffer lover.

programme.title: The Pink Panther 2
programme.desc: Inspector Jacques Clouseau teams up with a squad of international detectives just as bumbling as he is. Their mission: Stop a globe-trotting thief who specializes in stealing historical artifacts.

programme.title: Revenge of the Pink Panther
programme.desc: Peter Sellers’ comedic genius shines when the hapless Inspector Clouseau is presumed to be dead. However, the very much alive Inspector travels to Hong Kong to investigate a dangerous drug lord (Robert Webber). Dyan Cannon and Herbert Lom also star.

programme.title: Pink Panther Strikes Again
programme.desc: Chief Inspector Dreyfus (Herbert Lom) is finally driven mad by Inspector Clouseau's (Peter Sellers) incompetence and commandeers a doomsday device along with a demand for Clouseau’s death. Are 26 hired assassins a match for Clouseau's dumb luck?

programme.title: Curse of the Pink Panther
programme.desc: Inspector Clouseau is missing and the Pink Panther (David Niven) is hot on his trail in this wildly funny laugh-fest that offers plenty of slapstick humor and a myriad of stars including Joanna Lumley, Herbert Lom and Robert Wagner.

programme.title: The Bounty
programme.desc: The story of a 1789 mutiny on the H.M.S. Bounty in which a voyage to Tahiti turns a crew against its Captain when they find tropical paradise and unlimited sex, but the Captain decides to leave and take his crew on a perilous voyage around Cape Horn.

programme.title: Annie Hall
programme.desc: Woody Allen is in prime form in this celebrated comedy and 1977 Best Picture Oscar®-winner in which he portrays a highly neurotic comedy writer who falls head-over-heels in love with a naive small-town girl (Diane Keaton) who aspires to be a singer.

programme.title: Frankie and Johnny
programme.desc: Join Elvis Presley and Donna Douglas for a riverboat ride of rollicking musical entertainment in this charming and sassy comic hit about a gambler and his lady love.

programme.title: Big Momma's House
programme.desc: In order to protect a woman from a robber, a male FBI agent disguises himself as an elderly woman.

programme.title: Big Momma's House 2
programme.desc: An FBI agent reprises his disguise as an old lady to become a nanny in a crime suspect's house.

programme.title: Big Mommas: Like Father, Like Son
programme.desc: Malcolm Turner and his stepson Trent go undercover at an all-girls performing arts school

programme.title: Love, Rosie
programme.desc: Love, Rosie is a heart-warming, modern comedy-of-errors about Rosie and Alex. As each navigates the complexities of life, love, and everything in between, they always find their way back to each other - but is it just friendship, or something more?

programme.title: Uptown Girls (2003)
programme.desc: Molly Gunn is the daughter of a late rock legend, and the toast of New York City. But when her inheritance is stolen, Molly is forced to do something she's never done before - get a job. Molly becomes a nanny to a girl, who is "eight going on forty."

programme.title: Over the Top
programme.desc: A Championship title, a huge cash award, and his son's love -- the greatest prize of all -- are at stake when Hawk battles his strongest enemy for everything he has ever wanted.

programme.title: Austin Powers: International Man of Mystery
programme.desc: Frozen in the '60s, secret agent Austin Powers is thawed back into action to once again battle his archenemy Dr. Evil. With his sexy sidekick, Ms. Kensington, Austin must stop Dr. Evil's outrageous plot to control the world.

programme.title: Noah
programme.desc: Russell Crowe stars as Noah in the timeless story of courage, sacrifice, and hope. This visually stunning, action-adventure is hailed as "one of the most unforgettable Biblical epics ever put on film." *Richard Roeper, Chicago-Sun-Times

programme.title: The Big Short
programme.desc: Based on the true story of four outsiders who saw what the big banks, media, and government refused to: the global collapse of the economy. A bold investment leads them into the dark underbelly of banking, where everyone and everything is in question.

programme.title: My Super Ex-Girlfriend
programme.desc: When he breaks up with his girlfriend, he discovers his ex is actually the reluctant superhero, G Girl. A scorned woman, she unleashes her super powers to humiliate and torment him.

programme.title: I'm Still Here
programme.desc: Oscar®-nominated actor Casey Affleck, in his directorial debut, together with fellow Oscar® nominee Joaquin Phoenix blow the roof off of conventional fi lmmaking in this unique and groundbreaking experimental project.

programme.title: Bring It On
programme.desc: In this classic teen comedy packed with energy and sharp humour, a champion high school cheerleading squad discovers its previous captain stole all their best routines, and now must scramble to compete at this year's championships. Starring Kirsten Dunst.

programme.title: Monte Carlo
programme.desc: Grace becomes a princess when a summer trip to Paris turns into the fantasy of a lifetime.

programme.title: Push
programme.desc: Superhumans defy a government plot to harness and abuse their powers. Chris Evans and Dakota Fanning (the TWILIGHT films) team in a pulse-pounding paranormal thriller.

programme.title: Unfinished Business
programme.desc: A hard-working small business owner and his two associates travel to Europe to close the most important deal of their lives. But what began as a routine business trip goes off the rails in every way imaginable, and unimaginable.

programme.title: Lars and the Real Girl
programme.desc: Lars Lindstrom is an akwardly shy young man in a small town who finally brings home the girl of his dreams to his brother and sister-in-law's home. The only problem is that she's not real - she's a sex doll.

programme.title: Warrior (2011)
programme.desc: WARRIOR tells the moving and inspirational story of the Conlon family, Brendan (Joel Edgerton), Tommy (Tom Hardy) and Paddy (Nick Nolte), who find redemption in the ring as they fight to repair themselves and their family.

programme.title: The Big Man
programme.desc: When unemployed Scottish miner Danny Scoular (Liam Neeson) agrees to fight a one-off bare-knuckle bout, he not only risks losing his wife and kids, but enters a hellish domain lorded over by a ruthless Glasgow gang boss.

programme.title: Hurricane Season
programme.desc: In the wake of Hurricane Katrina, high school basketball coach Al Collins assembles students from five different Louisiana schools and leads them all the way to the state championships.

programme.title: Beer League
programme.desc: An unemployed slacker inspires his softball teammates to improve their game so they won't get kicked out of the local league.

programme.title: The Foul King
programme.desc: A timid bank clerk transforms into a wrestling villain in this comedy starring Song Kang-ho (Parasite, Broker).

programme.title: Studs
programme.desc: Emmet Rovers are the team at the bottom of the league, and after losing their manager they are now faced with the loss of their home grounds. Maybe a manager can bring some luck for the team

programme.title: The Hero
programme.desc: Richard Harris stars in – and co-directs – this powerful story of an aging soccer player whose life is crumbling. All he has left is a devoted 12-year old fan – and a desire to live free.

programme.title: Gracie
programme.desc: A teenager faces an uphill battle when she fights to give women the opportunity to play competitive soccer.

programme.title: Breakfast with Johnny Wilkinson
programme.desc: An engaging British comedy set on the day of the Rugby World Cup Final in 2003 between England and Australia. Dave, a local rugby club chairman is locked in a bitter power-struggle with the team coach, who has come in to gloat at England's likely defeat.

programme.title: Joe and Max
programme.desc: True story of boxers Joe Louis and Max Schmeling and their enduring friendship.

programme.title: Bigger
programme.desc: A rags-to-riches biopic of visionary Joe Weider, set in the world of fitness. Brothers Joe & Ben Weider were the architects of muscle.

programme.title: MVP

programme.desc: Fourteen-year-old Joe is the only child of Jeanette and Jerry - a housewife and a golf pro - living a seemingly idyllic life in 1960s Montana. His family's carefully constructed façade is about to come crashing spectacularly down however, when Jerry loses his job - and his sense of purpose. In an attempt to restore his pride, Jerry takes off for the summer to help fight the wildfires raging near the Canadian border, a life-threatening job, for very little pay. An angry and bereft Jeanette must quickly learn to fend for herself, and does so with gusty, challenging cultural expectations and taking a quietly bewildered Joe along for the ride. An elegant adaption of the Richard Ford novel of the same name, Wildlife is an impressive directorial debut from Golden Globe nominee Paul Dano (There Will Be Blood, Love & Mercy), starring Carey Mulligan (Never Let Me Go, An Education, Shame, Suffragette), Jake Gyllenhaal (Nightcrawler, Brokeback Mountain, Donnie Darko), Ed Oxenbould (The Visit, Paper Planes) and Bill Camp (The Night Of, Loving, Midnight Special).

programme.title: World War A - When Aliens Attack
programme.desc: Scientists are already looking feverishly for evidence of extraterrestrial life. With the ExoMars mission, ESA will soon find life on Mars. If there are only tiny microbes, there could also be life in other places in the universe. But can life in space exist at all? The exobiologist Jean-Pierre de Vera collects microorganisms around the world and tests them in his Mars simulation laboratory. Can they survive under the deadly conditions of Mars? Researchers believe there are planets on which alien life can exist. In 1991 the Swiss astrophysicist Michel Mayor discovered the world's first exoplanet. Since then, about 3,000 planets have been detected outside our solar system. Heike Rauer from the German Aerospace Center is looking for habitable planets. Will she find a second earth? The European Southern Observatory is also searching for life in space, building the largest telescope in the world. In the next 20 years the E-ELT should be able to prove the existence of life on distant planets. How would extraterrestrials look? Some scientists suspect that they may well resemble us humans. Under other environmental conditions, alien life could also arise completely differently. It could be formed from methane and silicon. Different gravity would form alien bodies completely differently. Could extraterrestrials send us messages? At the SETI Institute in California, alien hunters like Seth Shostak are listening to signals from alien civilizations. But mere listening is no longer enough. Some SETI researchers now want to send messages to the aliens themselves. They hope to finally get an answer. But would that be a bad idea? Many scientists warn of the dangers of establishing contact. The former SETI researcher and science fiction author David Brin also fears that it could be a devastating mistake. With well-meant news we could end up attracting attention from hostile civilizations. Should we really tell them that we exist and where they can find us?
